thread:
jamie: gitops-bot just flagged a reconcile alert for inference-gpu namespace — prod has a SNAT-config that staging doesn't. egress to driver registries failing :grimacing:

/devops-bot: [reconcile-alert] repo=infra-gitops path=overlays/prod/inference/egress-snat.yaml diff=present->absent

olivia: wait, prod has the SNAT iptables-rule applied via kustomize patch? didn't we move that to cloud-router last month?

sami: I saw failed node provisioning in us-west-2 earlier. pods stuck pulling driver images -> `ImagePullBackOff` for `nvidia-driver-installer`.

patrick: can someone paste `kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide`? also `kubectl describe node` for taints.

jamie: here are quick extracts

```
$ kubectl -n inference get pods
NAME                                   READY  STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
gpu-driver-installer-7b6c8            0/1    ImagePullBackOff    0          12m
inference-worker-0                    1/1    Running             0          10m
```

olivia: this explains autoscaler fallback: nodes not joining -> dedicated GPU pool didn't scale -> we fell back to reserved on-demand instances in eu-west-1 for some routes, cost spike noticed in last billing alert.

sami: repo diff shows prod overlay adds `egressSnat: true` in `values.yaml` for `cloud-network` helm chart. staging overlay removed it to test direct routing.

patrick: hm, so gitops detects absent SNAT in prod overlay? that seems backwards.

jamie: root cause: someone removed the SNAT kustomize patch in staging overlay but not prod; flux detects mismatch because live cluster has cloud-router managed SNAT in prod. In staging the cloud-router never got the route, so image pulls to driver registry timed out in some regions with strict egress.

olivia: quick mitigation: re-add SNAT patch to staging overlay and reconcile, or update cluster-network to use shared NAT gateway. which is less risky?

sami: short-term: re-add patch and reconcile to restore image pulls. long-term: move to shared NAT per runbook Network->egress: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/network-egress

patrick: OK. I will create a PR to overlays/staging/inference/egress-snat.yaml and tag @olivia for review. Then run `gitopsctl sync --path overlays/staging/inference --kustomize`

jamie: sounds good. Also let's run `terraform plan -target=module.cloud-router` to ensure no TF drift.

/devops-bot: apply started for PR #438 (staging). CI passed. canary deploy to staging initiated.

olivia: PR merged, running `gitopsctl diff` now.

/infra-oncall: monitoring note — enable alert suppression for the reconcile until sync completes to reduce noise.

sami: after reconcile, confirm `kubectl -n inference get pods` shows driver installer -> Running, and autoscaler returns to GPU pool.

patrick: I've left a follow-up ticket INFRA-812 to consolidate egress config across overlays and prevent this by adding a policy-check in the GitOps CI: block PRs that change `egressSnat` without a `network-impact` label.

jamie: assigned. cost note: temporary fallback added ~0.8K USD over last 3 hours. tagging on billing.

olivia: nice triage team. I'll post a short blurb in #all-hands about transient capacity interruption and cost impact.

jamie: thanks — closing once autoscaler healthy and infra-oncall confirms no more ImagePullBackOffs.
